common.description: The Anbani.ge project is a Georgian-language web application platform that aims to enrich and support the Internet space with all levels of our writing.
common.inspiration: Anbani.ge supports the initiative of Bumberazi linguist Akaki Shanidze to introduce the round capital letter as the main upper case letter of the Georgian script. Unfortunately, despite great efforts, this idea could not be implemented in Soviet Georgia, although it is never too late.
